- [IRET.1.4c] **Enforcement.** Two guards. (1) The
    refcount-**underflow assertion** in `release` (double-free /
    lifecycle imbalance) — load-bearing. (2) The pinned-set
    **freeze**: after setup a new PINNED insert is a hard error.
    It is **armed** at the setup→runtime boundary (first pump).
    The freeze's trigger ("zero runtime pinned inserts") is exact
    once the small, program-structure-bounded **first-pump
    sentinel set** — `""` (a live fact's `corr` on a hydration target) and
    `$ClockTick` (`ds_rete_engine_tick_clock`), which the
    engine interns pinned lazily at first pump rather than at
    load — is **pre-pinned before the freeze arms**. That set is
    verified complete by enumeration across the asserts-on
    surfaces. Boundedness is additionally observable via the SI3
    **pinned watermark** (`ds.intern.pinned_entries`, [NMET.4]),
    which stays flat under value churn.
